verdict.rationale: The Emerging Companies & Growth page states Latham advises on 'hundreds of emerging company financings totaling billions of dollars every year' and covers 'angel and seed investments to structured debt and equity solutions,' plus explicit mention of guiding startups 'of all sizes' and connecting to VC investors, giving stated deal volume and range from seed to growth stage. However, there is no breakdown by round stage (seed/Series A/late-stage) or representative named transactions specific to priced equity rounds—only aggregate volume language and glossary/tooling support (LathamDrive, Book of Jargon) that touches formation/capital-raising terminology rather than itemized deal examples. Missing for 10: stage-by-stage deal breakdown (seed vs Series A vs late-stage), named representative transactions/case studies, and independent corroboration of deal volume claims.
